sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash preview - Gemini API
sources.evidence: Exact model code and preview name; text/image/video/audio/PDF inputs, text output, 1,048,576 input tokens and 65,536 output tokens; Thinking and Function calling supported. Page last updated October 9, 2026. Reopened October 27, 2026: the exact model specification table contains no numerical total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash Model Card - December 2025
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 reread of the complete December 2025 card, now served as the official PDF. It explicitly identifies Gemini 3 Pro as the model dependency and delegates architecture to that card. No numerical total or active count appears; benchmark and safety comparisons do not contain a size column.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card - updated May 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 reread of the complete Pro card, updated May 2026. It explicitly includes Gemini 3 Flash among its dependent models and describes sparse MoE routing. Neither this named base nor the Flash variant has a published numerical total, active count or routing dimension in this document. The Pro model itself is explicitly not a fine-tune of a prior model.

sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 full-card check: its exact Gemini 3 Flash comparison column reports benchmark results, pricing and safety changes, without total or activated parameter counts. Its named dependency is Gemini 3 Flash; no numerical size is available for inheritance in either direction.

sources.title: SFT Drives Gemini’s Safety Properties - June 13, 2026

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API access is governed by Google API and Gemini service terms, including restrictions on extracting or replicating model parameter weights. Supports proprietary service classification; the documentation footer licenses documentation, not model weights.

name.note: Official preview name and exact API identifier match the baseline.

developer.note: Developed and published by Google DeepMind; Google is the catalog developer label.

family.note: Normalized catalog label for the Flash branch of the Gemini 3 model series, not an official literal family identifier.

release_date.note: Explicit first public API preview launch date; not a later product rollout or successor release.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is a proprietary hosted model through products/APIs; no downloadable weight release is provided by the reviewed primary distribution sources.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the hosted model under Google service terms, not an SPDX weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-name and exact-ID total-size and named-base searches, original Flash/Pro cards and launch, first-party training research, and later comparison cards found no supported nominal total. The Flash card explicitly names Gemini 3 Pro as its dependency, but that base has no published numerical size either. This null reflects absent count evidence, not a requirement for an exact tensor census or hosted-service attestation.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 searches separately checked active/activated counts and later first-party comparison tables. Sparse routing is documented through the named Pro dependency, but no numerical activated count, expert count or routing dimensions establish an active size for either model. Benchmarks, throughput and token-use reductions are not parameter counts.

architecture.note: The exact Flash architecture section explicitly delegates to Gemini 3 Pro; that linked card identifies a sparse MoE Transformer. This is documented inheritance, not inference from a sibling name. Expert counts and dimensions remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: Exact published input-token limit; output-token limit is separately 65,536. Documentation verification does not establish a successful live endpoint call.

modalities.note: Exact model table confirms all five inputs and text output. PDF is a supported document input format.

reasoning.note: Exact API entry supports Thinking; original card describes adjustable thinking levels.

tool_call.note: Exact API entry explicitly supports Function calling.

research_notes.parameter_search: Fresh October 27 search of Gemini 3 Flash and gemini-3-flash-preview with total, active, activated, billion/trillion, parameter-count and named-base terms. Reopened the original Flash PDF, its named Pro dependency, exact API page, launch announcement and Google DeepMind training research; inspected later 3.1 Pro, 3.5/3.6/3.7/3.8 Flash, Argon card and full Argon safety report for count disclosures. No supported numerical total or active count was found. The original launch’s 1T tokens/day is throughput, not model size. Pricing/API generation parameters and larger-model comparisons do not supply a count.
research_notes.architecture_search: Targeted Google DeepMind, Google Research, arXiv and interpretability searches supplemented the direct Flash-to-Pro architecture reference. The June 13 first-party training update names production Gemini 3 Flash but supplies no extra structural dimensions.
research_notes.access: Original API, launch and first-party training-research pages reopened through the web reader on October 27. Complete official cards and safety report were freshly fetched HTTP 200 in /tmp/google-parameter-primary-cache/manifest.json and inspected as text; the Argon HTML was gzip-decoded. Only this model report was edited.
research_notes.parameter_lineage_review: The original Flash card explicitly names Gemini 3 Pro and delegates architecture/training to it. Named-base nominal inheritance is allowed, but no count is published for that base. The Pro card identifies itself as a new model and supplies no earlier count-bearing checkpoint. Later Flash cards document a dependency chain but no retrospective numeric size. No exact tensor census was required.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit retains explicit null total and active counts after exact-model searches, original evidence reinspection, named Pro dependency review and later primary comparison checks. No numerical specification was found for Flash or its named base. Preserve all unrelated audited fields and corrections.
